objective: Complete fixed-coefficient restitution comparison and assess evidence for condition-dependent coefficients without substituting missing geometry.
holdout: All release-height4.5m observations; no parameters selected from these outcomes. Training uses2.5/3.5m.
extra_validation: Leave one complete landing-plate-angle group out, four folds; train and holdout separation by experimental condition.
candidate_models: linear impact-angle dependence with physical bounds
assumptions: homogeneous sphere inertia rather than unavailable actual facet meshes
zero incoming spin approximation; reported norm<=3rad/s
coplanar signed velocity reconstruction from published magnitudes
fit_residuals: normal and tangential outgoing velocities and R*angular speed, normalized by incoming total speed
native_verification: Run held-out fixed-coefficient cases through actual3D native solver and independently verify analytic endpoints and energy/work. Retain invalid cases/errors.
geometry_study: Fixed coefficients for non-spherical2D rectangles and3D boxes/hulls; vary attitude, velocity direction and incidence without fitting any material coefficient.
interpretation: Model fit improvements identify predictive condition dependence only under sphere assumptions; unavailable actual contact points prevent material-location/direction identification. No full actual-shape or independent material proof claim.
